# Econometrics, statistics, and data science: Reinstein notes

> David Reinstein's working notes on econometrics, statistics, experiment and survey design, and data science, with a focus on micro, behavioral and experimental economics.

By David Reinstein (https://www.davidreinstein.org/). More projects: https://projects.davidreinstein.org/
